answers.core: It's an integrated usability improvement that boils down to adding a checkbox in dialog box and adding the code to make it functional. It seems too low key for needing an entire add-on in the asset library.
answers.workaround: While a script program could attempt something like this; this is more of a usability improvement. A quick way to generate a new collision mesh and visually inspect it to look good.
